caption: The drawing depicts a single pitcher, shown in full profile against a plain, light beige background. The pitcher is predominantly brown with a marbled, mottled pattern and contains highlights of lighter beige and cream. The pitcher has a curving spout and an ornate handle. Along its side, there is a raised relief decoration in the form of a large anchor with a chain that loops around the anchor and attaches at two separate points on the body of the pitcher. The anchor detail is shaded to appear three-dimensional and slightly elevated from the surface of the pitcher. The rim and handle of the pitcher also have textured detailing. The artist’s signature, “ELEANOR GAUSSER”, appears in light, small letters at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Rockingham Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
